description.narrative: The project will support the construction of the 54.6-kilometer (km) Blumentritt-Calamba section of the North-South Commuter Railway connecting Metro Manila and Calamba, located in Laguna Province around 50 km south of Manila. The Project will provide improved connectivity in the public transport network by connecting with all existing LRT/MRT-lines in Metro Manila. It includes a connecting line to the planned Metro Manila Subway, which will improve connectivity by operating direct trains for passengers travelling from Calamba to Bonifacio Global City, Ortigas and Quezon City along the Metro Manila Subway. The new railway line will provide affordable, reliable and safe public transport, reduce greenhouse gas emissions and cut the journey time by half to less than one hour. The project will be cofinanced by Japan International Cooperation Agency. The government is also constructing the 37 km Tutuban-Malolos section and the 53.1 km Malolos-Clark Railway Project (MFF Facility Concept 0106-PHI). It is also planned to further extend the project toward the north by 18 km to connect the New Clark City to Clark.

Output 2 activities have not yet commenced as DOTr has focused its resources on advancing ROW acquisition and early onstruction works during the initial stage of L4188-PHI. On 8 May 2025 DOTr informed ADB at a meeting that it is currently finalizing the detailed activities of the Output 2 of both the SCRP and the MFF Malolos-Clark Railway Project (MCRP), to optimally suite the changing circumstances of these two projects including the partial operation target for the MCRP by 2028, ongoing preparation for procurement of an operation and maintenance contract for the railway projects in Metro Manila, and the changes in the DOTr leadership and organization. ADB and DOTr agreed that it will finalize and agree on a detailed program for activities for the delivery of Output 2 by the end of 2025.
